# gfm

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-001 — Bare URLs become safe links](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-001.md) — When prose contains a bare http://, https:// or www. URL, the extension SHALL render it as a link that follows the Markdown link policy, opening www. URLs as https://, leaving trailing sentence punctuation and unbalanced closing parentheses outside the link, and leaving unlinked any text that has another meaning or another scheme.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-002 — Trailing punctuation stays outside bare URLs](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-002.md) — When a bare URL is followed by sentence punctuation or an unbalanced closing parenthesis, the extension SHALL leave that character outside the link and keep balanced parentheses inside it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-003 — Text with a meaning is not autolinked](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-003.md) — When a URL-like string sits in code, math, raw HTML, an existing link, image, reference, directive option or e-mail address, or is glued to a preceding word character, the extension SHALL leave it unlinked.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-004 — Only http, https and www hosts are autolinked](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-004.md) — When prose contains javascript:, data:, ftp: or vbscript: text, or a www. candidate without a dotted host, the extension SHALL NOT create a link from it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-005 — Autolinks follow the Markdown link policy](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-005.md) — When a bare URL is rendered as a link, the extension SHALL pass it through the same sanitizer and navigation routing as a Markdown link.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-006 — Editing an autolink shows the raw URL](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-006.md) — When a writer opens a paragraph containing an autolinked URL for editing, the extension SHALL send the unchanged source text, including the raw URL, to the block editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-007 — Pathological URLs render in linear time](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-007.md) — When a document contains a URL with 50 000 closing parentheses or 100 000 characters, the extension SHALL render it in under one second.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-008 — Strikethrough, footnotes and pipe tables render as on GitHub](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-008.md) — When prose contains ~~text~~, a footnote reference with its definition, or a GFM pipe table, the extension SHALL render the text struck through, the reference with its footnote text, and the table header with the alignment of the delimiter row on every cell of the column, leaving a single ~x~ pair and tildes in code literal.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-009 — GitHub alerts render as admonitions](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-009.md) — When a block quote starts with \[!NOTE\], \[!TIP\], \[!IMPORTANT\], \[!WARNING\] or \[!CAUTION\] in any case, the extension SHALL render it as an admonition of that type with the default title and the quoted lines as Markdown body, using the text after the marker as the title and ending the admonition at the first unquoted line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-010 — Alert marker text becomes the title](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-010.md) — When an alert marker is followed by text on its line, the extension SHALL use that text as the admonition title.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-011 — Legacy bold markers render as admonitions](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-011.md) — When a block quote line contains only **Note**, **Important** or **Warning** in any case, the extension SHALL render the quote as a simple admonition of that type.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-012 — Alert markers inside fences stay literal](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-012.md) — When an alert marker appears inside a fenced code block, the extension SHALL keep it as literal code.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-013 — Alerts render the same in CRLF documents](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-013.md) — When a document uses CRLF line endings, the extension SHALL render alerts and fences exactly as for the same LF document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-014 — Footnotes render reference and text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-014.md) — When a document contains a footnote reference and its definition, the extension SHALL render the reference and the footnote text.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-015 — Pipe tables keep header and column alignment](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-015.md) — When a GFM pipe table has alignment markers in its delimiter row, the extension SHALL render the header and apply that alignment to every cell of the column.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-016 — Task list markers render as checkboxes with their source position](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-016.md) — When a task-list item, paragraph, table cell, directive body or admonition title contains \[ \], \[x\] or \[X\], the extension SHALL render a checkbox carrying its source line and UTF-16 column, marking a task-list item so that the checkbox replaces the bullet and keeping the checkbox input and its attributes in the sanitized webview HTML.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-017 — Task-list checkboxes sit in the bullet gutter](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-017.md) — When a list item starts with a checkbox marker, the extension SHALL mark the item and its list as task-list-item and contains-task-list so the checkbox replaces the bullet.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-018 — Checkbox markers stay literal where they have another meaning](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-018.md) — When \[ \] or \[x\] occurs in code, math, diagrams, link text or URLs, images, ATX headings, raw HTML, directive arguments, an escape, wikilink or reference syntax, the extension SHALL keep it as literal text, except that \[ \] still renders as a checkbox when \[x\] is a defined reference label.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-019 — CRLF documents keep exact checkbox columns](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-019.md) — When a document uses CRLF line endings, the extension SHALL give each checkbox the same line and column as in the LF document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-020 — The webview keeps checkbox inputs](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-020.md) — When the rendered HTML is sanitized for the webview, the extension SHALL keep checkbox inputs and their source line, column and state attributes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-021 — Clicking a checkbox toggles one source character](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-021.md) — When a writer clicks a checkbox in reading or edit mode, the extension SHALL edit only the character between its brackets, without opening a block editor, and revert the checkbox with the reason in its tooltip when the host refuses the toggle.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-022 — A checkbox toggle is one undo step](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-022.md) — When a checkbox toggle is applied, the extension SHALL apply it as a single undo step of the source document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-023 — A pending toggle blocks further clicks](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-023.md) — When the host is processing a checkbox toggle, the extension SHALL mark the checkbox aria-busy and ignore further clicks on it until the result arrives.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-024 — A refused toggle reverts the checkbox with a reason](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-024.md) — When the host refuses a checkbox toggle, the extension SHALL revert the checkbox and put the reason in its tooltip.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-025 — Checkbox clicks are refused during an open edit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-025.md) — When a block editor or the frontmatter editor is open, the extension SHALL refuse a checkbox click and show 'Save or cancel this edit before toggling a checkbox.' in the editor status.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-026 — Read-only previews disable checkboxes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-026.md) — When the preview cannot edit the document, the extension SHALL disable checkboxes with the tooltip 'Editing requires a trusted workspace.' and refuse a toggle message with the same text.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-027 — The host validates checkbox toggle messages](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-027.md) — When the host receives a previewCheckboxToggle message, the extension SHALL accept it only with a safe non-negative integer column, a boolean checked state and a single line, and accept column and checked on no other message type.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-028 — Content patches clear pending toggles](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-028.md) — When the preview content is patched in place, the extension SHALL discard pending checkbox toggles so an old result cannot revert the new content.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-029 — A small raw HTML subset renders and the rest is dropped](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-029.md) — When a document contains raw HTML, the extension SHALL render a raw details element with optional open and a plain summary element, in one block or as head, body and closing blocks, as a collapsible section (with the summary Details when empty), and a kbd element without attributes as a key cap, and omit raw HTML outside the supported subset from the rendering.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-030 — Raw kbd renders as a key cap](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-030.md) — When inline text contains a kbd element without attributes, the extension SHALL render a keyboard key cap.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-031 — Raw HTML tables are rebuilt from an allow-list](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-031.md) — When a document contains a raw HTML table, the extension SHALL rebuild it from an allow-list of tags and attributes, rendering its cells with rowspan and colspan from 1 to 999, align, scope, simple class names, title and a sanitized style subset, and removing script, style, iframe, svg, form, embed and object elements with their content and dropping comments.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-032 — Raw table styles keep a sanitized subset](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-032.md) — When a raw HTML table element has a style, the extension SHALL keep only text and background colours, text-fill, background-clip text and linear gradients, removing other declarations with a diagnostic.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-033 — Unsupported raw HTML is dropped](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-033.md) — When a document contains raw HTML outside the supported subset, the extension SHALL omit it from the rendering.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-034 — Colour spans keep safe colours only](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-034.md) — When a span style declares color or background-color as hex or comma-separated rgb()/rgba(), the extension SHALL keep the colours as data attributes and apply them on the page only after revalidating each value, removing named colours, var(), url(), !important, comments and other properties, and recording the sanitizer diagnostic 'Removed unsafe style attribute.' for a removed declaration.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-035 — The page revalidates span colours before applying](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-035.md) — When the page applies kept span colours, the extension SHALL set them through the CSSOM after revalidating each value with the colour grammar, only under the preview content.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-036 — Removed span styles record a diagnostic](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-036.md) — When a colour span style contains a removed declaration, the extension SHALL record the sanitizer diagnostic 'Removed unsafe style attribute.'.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-037 — Alerts end at the first unquoted line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-037.md) — When the lines after an alert marker stop being quoted, the extension SHALL end the admonition at the first unquoted line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-038 — Raw HTML tables remove active content](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-038.md) — When a raw HTML table contains script, style, iframe, svg, form, embed or object elements, the extension SHALL remove them with their content and drop comments.
